India has natural as well as man-made boundaries. Himalaya 
in the north, Bay of Bengal in the south-east, Indian Ocean 
in the south and Arabian sea in the south-west forms it's 
natural boundary. India shares its border with China (Tibet), 
Bangladesh, Afghanistan, Pakistan, Bhutan, Nepal, Maldive, 
Sri Lanka and Myanmar. Radcliffe line demarcates the border 
between India and Pakistan and Macmahon line between 
India and China. Durand line demarcates the border between 
India and Afghanistan. Sri Lanka is separated from India by 
the Palk Strait. It is about 64-137 km wide. It was named 
after the then Governor of Madras Robert Palk.

local time at 1200 East longitude –
questions.explanation_en:
The longitudinal difference between the Indian Standard 
Time and 120°E longitude is 120° – 82°30'= 37°30'. Since 
the difference of 1 longitude is equal to 4 minutes. So 
the difference in time between them is 37°30' × 4= 150 
minutes (means 2 hours, 30 minutes).Thus, if it is noon at 
IST meridian, then the local time at 120° East longitude is 
12:00+2:30=14:30.

towards the sun and therefore the northern hemisphere has 
days ranging from just over 12 hours around to 24 hours in 
Arctic Circle. Delhi is the most appropriate answer as it is 
the most northerly given option.

questions.section: Indian Geography: General Introduction, Location & Frontiers
questions.question_en:
Consider the following statements regarding India's maritime and land frontiers:
1. India's territorial waters extend into the sea up to a distance of 12 nautical miles from the appropriate baseline.
2. The Contiguous Zone of India extends up to 24 nautical miles from the baseline.
3. India's Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) extends up to 200 nautical miles from the baseline.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
[भारत का भूगोल: समुद्री सीमाएँ • U.P.P.C.S. / I.A.S. Maritime Zones]
भारत की समुद्री और स्थलीय सीमाओं के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. भारत का प्रादेशिक जल (Territorial Waters) आधार रेखा से 12 समुद्री मील (Nautical Miles) तक विस्तृत है।
2. संलग्न क्षेत्र (Contiguous Zone) आधार रेखा से 24 समुद्री मील तक है।
3. अनन्य आर्थिक क्षेत्र (EEZ) आधार रेखा से 200 समुद्री मील तक विस्तृत है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-से कथन सही हैं?
questions.explanation_en: Under the Territorial Waters, Continental Shelf, Exclusive Economic Zone and Other Maritime Zones Act, 1976 (and UNCLOS 1982): (1) Territorial Sea extends up to 12 nautical miles (1 NM = 1.852 km) from the baseline; (2) Contiguous Zone extends up to 24 nautical miles; and (3) Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) extends up to 200 nautical miles. Hence all three statements (1, 2 and 3) are correct.
questions.explanation_hi: आधिकारिक व्याख्या: समुद्री क्षेत्र अधिनियम 1976 एवं UNCLOS के अनुसार भारत की प्रादेशिक समुद्री सीमा 12 समुद्री मील, संलग्न क्षेत्र 24 समुद्री मील तथा अनन्य आर्थिक क्षेत्र (EEZ) 200 समुद्री मील तक है। अतः विकल्प (D) सही है।
